---
name: Proposal
about: Discuss a bounded change before substantial work
---

<!-- Use English and discuss substantial changes before implementation.
Keep credentials, private configurations and sensitive reports out of issues.
Use the template chooser's private routes for security or conduct reports. -->

## Problem and intended outcome

Who needs this, what problem does it solve, and what observable result is wanted?

## Scope and roadmap

Which roadmap stage does this support? What belongs in this delivery, and what
is deferred? Distinguish the desk MVP, future library vision and active promotion.

## Evidence and open questions

What public sources, versions, observations or prior research support this?
Which blocking questions need investigation? Do not assume unmeasured results.

## Suggested approach (optional)

Describe a possible approach and alternatives without treating them as settled.

## Related work (optional)

Link issues or an existing OpenSpec change. An initial discussion does not need
to arrive with a complete change or implementation.
